svg.aria-label: Otto on a Mac: hold Control Option Space and ask it to reply to Jordan. A small island drips out of the notch while it listens, Otto checks Gmail in the background, waits under the notch for you to allow the send, then shows the result.

g.text: Hold ⌃ ⌥ Space and say what you need
Let go. It's transcribed on your Mac
Otto drips out of the notch and works in the background
Anything that sends or changes waits for you
The result lands when it's done
• Move the launch review to Thursday
• Send the hiring plan to the team by Friday
Friday at 3 works. See you then!
